= Collapsible examples

.Before
====
Normal example before the disclosures.
====

[%collapsible]
.Collapsed block
====
Collapsed content remains visible in PDF.
====

[%collapsible%open]
.Open block
====
The open option produces the same expanded PDF content.
====

[%collapsible%closed]
====
An untitled disclosure uses the Details label.
====

[options="collapsible,open",caption="Ignored: "]
.Explicit options and caption
====
The caption override is ignored for a disclosure.
====

[example%collapsible]
Collapsible paragraph without a title.

[example%collapsible%closed]
.Collapsed paragraph
Collapsible paragraph with a title.

[example%collapsible]
.Styled open block
--
An example-styled open block is also a disclosure.
--

[%collapsible]
.Ordinary open block
--
The option does not turn an ordinary open block into an example.
--

[collapsible]
.Style, not option
====
The collapsible style remains a normal example.
====

.After
====
Normal example after the disclosures.
====
